leaf_morphology.secondary_veins: secondary veins clearly visible, moderately close, c. 5–8 pairs

traits.notes: Seedling shows simple, glossy green leaves with cordate to broadly ovate blades and mostly entire margins; venation is clearly visible with curved secondary veins; some leaves have holes present and small portions of margin missing; stems appear thin and flexible, and the seedling is leaning against nearby material rather than using specialized climbing structures; stipules, if present, are too small or obscured to be confidently evaluated.
